Synthetic documents generated by `scripts/generate-password-fixtures.py` with
`msoffcrypto-tool` (Office agile AES encryption) and `pypdf` (PDF AES-256).
Office inputs come from the controlled converter fixture generator.

- `agile.docx`, `agile.xlsx`, `agile.pptx`: password ` filens 密码🔐 `,
  including the leading and trailing spaces.
- `encrypted.pdf`: password `test123`.
- `tampered.docx`: same Office password, with one ciphertext byte changed.

These fixtures contain only synthetic test content. The independent writers
ensure tests exercise interoperability with actual encrypted bytes.

`reference/` contains the ECMA-376 Standard, RC4 CryptoAPI DOC/XLS/PPT and XOR
XLS interoperability fixtures from [msoffcrypto-tool](https://github.com/nolze/msoffcrypto-tool/tree/1f7925e388ac5a661b553adc97541a0972a8a80e/tests/inputs),
under the included MIT license. Their passwords are `Password1234_`, except the
XOR workbook whose password is `123456789012345`.
